summary: Add an unwired pure sidebar membership paging reducer

schema.detail: Crate-local page, scope, frontier and snapshot inputs; no wire schema change.

rules.detail: No admission or membership visibility change.

compatibility.detail: Hosts remain unwired. The reducer requires authoritative per-page collection frontier/count and matching stream metadata, including unchanged metadata after refresh; whole-host snapshot advancement does not invalidate collection reads. Only complete MembershipInput sets are exposed. The store-only collection-page work does not yet provide the required HTTP cursor/capability or stream epoch correspondence; adapters must wait for those contracts.

recovery.detail: Disconnect, automatic restart exhaustion and protocol refusal retain matching-scope stale complete data. Explicit refresh resets the three-attempt budget; no partial pages are persisted.
